title: Recombinant Protein Affinity Purification With SDS-PAGE QC

steps.summary: Resuspend the bacterial pellet, mechanically lyse it, clarify the lysate, and retain an input QC aliquot.
Equilibrate the nickel resin bed and discard the equilibration flowthrough.
Apply the remaining clarified lysate to the resin, bind the target, and collect flowthrough.
Wash the loaded resin three times, pool the washes, and retain a wash QC aliquot.
Elute the target protein into two imidazole fractions and retain QC aliquots.
Prepare input, flowthrough, wash, and elution fractions with reducing loading dye.
Heat and briefly centrifuge the prepared QC samples.
Load the prepared fractions and molecular-weight ladder into assigned SDS-PAGE lanes.
Run electrophoresis, rinse, stain, destain, and image the gel.
Record lane-level QC and return the purified fractions with the gel readout.
